correctness.rationale: The one-vacancy exclusion generator has Q_{i,i+1}=q w_{i+1} and Q_{i,i−1}=p w_{i−1}. Matrix-tree cofactors t_i>0 yield current (p w0 t1−q w1 t0)/Σt. For every L=3 sector, N=1 inverse-rate stationary weights and N=2 three-minor identity give currents odd in ε; empty/full are zero. For L=4,N=3, independent symbolic determinant expansion gives numerator abcd ε(1+ε²)/2 and Σt=[A(ε)+ε(1−ε²)UV(X−Y)]/8. The even current half-sum thus vanishes exactly when K=(a−c)(b−d)(a+c−b−d)=0, strictly nonzero for every 0<|ε|<1 otherwise; positivity comes from irreducible chain cofactors. Independent SymPy calculation checked the universal symbolic minors, even component and derivative.
